name: Alfried Krupp Wissenschaftskolleg Greifswald: Alfried Krupp Fellowships
summary: The Alfried Krupp Fellowships enable researchers from Germany and abroad to undertake a research stay at the Alfried Krupp Wissenschaftskolleg Greifswald. The fellowship programme supports outstanding research projects and promotes
